results.problem: Total variation bias of greedy maximal independent set on mixed spiders
results.quote: With _l_=2_<sup>k</sup>_-_k_ the total-variation bias is positive and satisfies \(b(T_{k,2^k-k})=O\left(\frac{\sqrt{k}}{4^k}\right)=O\left(\frac{\sqrt{logn_k}}{n_k^2}\right),n_k=2^k+k+1.\)
